description: Unified search across the whole network: 5k+ stories, 77 topic areas, 2.5k governance building blocks, papers, conversations, videos, tools, timelines, services, and vocabulary. Filter with types (posts, areas, guidance, rules, policies, standards, strategies, schema, properties, experiences, lifecycle, conversations, videos, papers, services, solutions, tools, timelines, vocabulary).

context.description: Optional: why you are asking. One sentence — the task you are trying to complete, or what you expect to get back. Never included in the answer and never used to rank; it is read only when a result turns out to be wrong, which is when knowing the intent is what makes the report actionable.

fields.description: Return only these keys on each record, e.g. ["slug","title","url"].

match.description: How multiple `tags` combine: "any" (default, at least one) or "all" (every tag).

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use with `limit` to walk a long list.

q.description: Free text over title, summary, tags, and body.

sort.description: Order when there is no `q`: "default" (dated content newest first, the rest A-Z), "title" (A-Z) or "date" (newest first). A `q` always orders by relevance.

tags.description: Tag slugs; match any by default.

types.description: Content types to include — plural resource names: posts, services, solutions, tools, areas, papers, videos, conversations, guidance, rules, policies, standards, strategies…, e.g. ["posts","papers"].

name: search_api_evangelist
